resolution: Implemented the collinear-name rule: roads continuing straight through an intersection (the two opposite arms sharing an axis) are ONE road and share a name. resolveRoadNames(strokes, junctions) union-finds the through-arms at every junction and resolves each group's name to the first segment a human named; planIntersectionProps + the IntersectionRail display use it, so naming one segment of Main propagates its name to the collinear continuation across the cross street and onto every street sign. Covered by a P4 test (named west half + unnamed east half across a vertical cross street → both resolve to Main). Part of the same feature as req_1480; shas shared.
